To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) there is a significant relationship between teacher education and teacher quality; (2) the relationship is positive, not negative, as is commonly assumed; (3) there are significant variations among teacher education institutions in their ability to prepare teachers of high quality; and (4) the variations among teacher education programs in preparing teachers of high quality are not explained by the characteristics of the students who enter the programs.
